full_prompt_en: A square architectural collage combines a softly photographic modern building with flat Bauhaus geometry on a warm cream field. The background is nearly empty and faintly speckled, giving the pale structure and the red forms considerable breathing room. A tall off-white building rises along the left side, with several narrow vertical shafts continuing close to the upper edge. Its dark stepped side recedes behind the brighter front wall. Toward the center, rounded balconies project from the façade in a staggered stack; their smooth white undersides contrast with charcoal railings and the dark recesses of the windows. A broad lower terrace reaches horizontally across the bottom edge, anchoring the vertical mass. A large vermilion disc occupies much of the right half behind the building, its clean circular boundary partly concealed by the balcony edges. A much smaller red circle sits high above it. Fine black and gray rules cross the composition horizontally and vertically, some extending past the building as if they belong to a precise graphic construction. Small red accents appear within a few windows, while the rest of the structure remains cream, gray, and deep blue-black. The light is even and gently warm from the upper left, with soft shadows on the recessed walls and dark bands beneath the projecting terraces. The architectural surfaces look smooth but lightly grainy, while the colored circles remain opaque, flat, and sharply cut. The overall composition balances a dense left-hand structure against expansive red geometry and cream negative space, producing a measured, quietly energetic modernist image.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形建筑拼贴在暖奶油色底面上结合了略带摄影感的现代建筑与平面的包豪斯几何形。背景几乎空白，带有细微斑点，使浅色建筑与红色图形周围留下充足空间。一座灰白建筑沿左侧升起，几条狭长的竖向结构延伸到靠近上边缘的位置。它深色的阶梯状侧面退到较亮的正立面后方。靠近中央，圆角阳台从立面层叠错开地伸出；光滑的白色底面与炭黑栏杆和窗户的深色凹处形成对比。宽阔的下层露台沿底边横向展开，稳住竖直体量。一个大朱红圆盘占据右半部的大部分区域，处在建筑后方，干净的圆形边界被阳台边缘遮去一部分。一个小得多的红圆位于其上方。纤细的黑灰直线横竖穿过构图，有些越过建筑继续延伸，仿佛属于精确的图形构造。少数窗内有小块红色强调，其余建筑保持奶油色、灰色与深蓝黑色。光线从左上方均匀而温暖地照入，在内凹墙面留下柔和阴影，在外挑露台下形成深色带。建筑表面光滑而略带颗粒感，彩色圆形则不透明、平整且裁切利落。整体构图以左侧密集的结构平衡宽大的红色几何形与奶油色留白，形成克制而有活力的现代主义画面。
style_prompt_en: The mixed photographic and graphic treatment sets softly modeled, lightly grainy volumes against opaque geometric color planes. Long, hairline rules and crisp circular boundaries give the forms a measured linear rhythm, while rounded edges soften the otherwise strict construction. Warm ivory occupies most of the field; vermilion carries the strongest visual weight, and small blue-black and gray accents establish depth. Illumination is broad and even, with shallow shadows confined to recesses and undersides rather than dramatic gradients. Sparse fine speckling keeps the light ground tactile without interrupting its openness. Dense vertical clusters are balanced by broad unmarked areas and a few decisive horizontal extensions. The result is restrained, precise, and quietly dynamic.
style_prompt_zh: 这种摄影与图形混合的处理，将柔和塑形、略带颗粒的体量与不透明的几何色面并置。发丝般的长直线和清晰的圆形边界赋予形体克制的线性节奏，圆润边缘则柔化了原本严整的构造。暖象牙白占据大部分画面；朱红承担最强的视觉重量，少量蓝黑和灰色强调建立纵深。照明宽泛而均匀，浅阴影局限于凹处与下沿，而非戏剧化渐变。稀疏的细斑让浅色底面保有触感，同时不破坏开阔感。密集的竖向聚合与大片未标记区域及少数明确的横向延伸相平衡。整体效果克制、精确，又暗含动势。
theme_en: A streamlined concrete building against a red geometric disc
theme_zh: 红色几何圆盘前的流线型混凝土建筑
name: Bauhaus
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
